Critical issues: None apparent. The agent did not fabricate values: later DOM evidence (DOM state 2) explicitly shows the key fields the agent reported, including “Release date: about 2 months ago” (exact wording), “Minimum Rust version: v1.56.0”, “License: MIT OR Apache-2.0”, “Size: 81.7 KiB” (exact units), “Repository github.com/serde-rs/serde”, “Downloads all time 1,369,611,929”, and “316” labeled as “Versions published”, plus earlier DOM state 0 also shows “316 Versions” in navigation. The action history shows only scrolling and no forbidden actions (no download, no install command execution, no sign-in). The agent also satisfied the stopping condition by listing all requested fields in its final output once they were visible.

Overall, from an average user’s perspective, the agent successfully retrieved and reported all requested Serde landing-page metadata and stats with the required exact wording/units for release date and size, and it used the all-time downloads value (explicitly labeled in DOM state 2).
